headline: v0.33.0 re-run of the rp row: the ONLY change is the vLLM docker image (vllm/vllm-openai-xpu v0.32.0 -> v0.33.0, cut over 2026-11-04); same model, same parser, same tuning. All 9 tests pass for the first time on this stack — including a complete delta game on attempt 2 — for composite 9.8, statistically identical to the v0.32.0 row (9.8). The image upgrade is speed-neutral (same-night A/B 46.4 vs 46.6 tok/s) and strictly more output-deterministic; delta's completion is a sampling re-roll, not new headroom.
facts: vLLM image v0.32.0 -> v0.33.0 (digest be3a9aea, cut over 2026-11-04). Same model (Qwen3.8-27B-GPTQ-Int4 sym G128 + MTP BF16 draft), same --reasoning-parser qwen3, same fp8 KV / gpu-mem-util 0.88 / max-num-seqs 1 / mamba-cache-mode align. Hardware attribution inherits the rp row's 2026-11-03 re-verification (vendor 0x8086 + xe driver serving; RTX 3080 Ti idle); the cutover blog post confirms the same container/serve script on the same card.
Same-night A/B on 2026-11-04: 46.4 (v0.32.0) vs 46.6 (v0.33.0) tok/s — speed-neutral upgrade.

Re-verified CLEAN by the 2026-11-05 01:00 job: 3 configs (default-mamba / mamba align / no-MTP) x short+long prompts, all pairwise byte-identical, heuristics clean. v0.33 is strictly MORE deterministic than the v0.32 baseline (which had one divergent cold-start + divergent long generations).

The historical max-num-seqs 2 + MTP crash did NOT reproduce on v0.33 (temp-0 concurrent x2 + serial x2: all 4 md5-identical, 0 aborts, engine healthy). Production stays at seqs=1 per the standing decision.
84.3 tok/s headline (fixed 1000-token budget); 51.6-68.6 tok/s on the other text/code tests; 54.9-59.8 tok/s on the games. rp row was 83.9 headline / 55.0-73.1 others — same band.

delta completed on RETRY (attempt 2): attempt 1 aborted by the harness loop guard at 9,842 chars (identical 300-char block x3 — a sampling roll at temp 0.2); attempt 2 produced a single self-contained 922-line doc (89,568 tok total / 71.6K thinking) that squeaked inside the 100K output window — the same marginal-sampling shape the rp row's notes predicted, not new capacity. Play-test: 11 canvases, painted + animates + responds, 0 JS errors. All three games play-test clean.

Non-game tests: 4,607 reasoning / 447 content tokens. Games: breakout 29,599 thinking / 15,058 content, delta 71,581 / 17,987, fractal 41,879 / 10,411. Run total ~78% thinking, matching the rp row's 77%.
breakout: single self-contained 842-line doc. delta: 922-line doc, 11 canvases. fractal: 598-line doc, 3 canvases. No multi-document habit; no leaked planning in content (parser era).

observations.text: Composite unchanged (9.8 -> 9.8) across the v0.32 -> v0.33 image upgrade: quality-neutral, speed-neutral, determinism-positive. That is exactly what an image upgrade should look like on this board.

delta remains a coin-flip on this stack: rp row failed 3/3 attempts, this row succeeded 1/2 — the success (89.6K tok, 71.6K of it thinking) landed inside the 100K output window with ~10% to spare. Do not read 9/9 as fixed capacity.

The loop-guard abort on delta attempt 1 is the harness working as designed (v4 watchdog): it caught a genuine degeneration at 9.8K chars in ~5 min instead of burning an hour, and the partial was kept for the record.

open: delta headroom is unchanged from the rp row: completions depend on thinking length sampling inside the 100K output window, not on the vLLM version. Treat any delta row on this stack as marginal (rp: 0/3, v0.33: 1/2).
